# Publishing the Titan Zero website

This repository is a static site. It has no server-side code. The live host must serve the files as they are.

## Source and generated files

- Edit page content in `pages/*.html` only.
- Each clean URL (for example `/pricing/`, `/frontdeskpro/`) is a folder containing an `index.html` copy of its source page in `pages/`. These copies are generated by the clean-URL sync step, so they should match their source files. Regenerate them after any edit to `pages/`.
- The homepage is `index.html`. The sitemap is `sitemap.xml`. `robots.txt` references the sitemap.

## Clean URL mapping

| Public URL | Source file |
|---|---|
| `/` | `index.html` |
| `/pricing/` | `pages/pricing.html` |
| `/terms/`, `/fair-use/` | `pages/terms.html`, `pages/fair-use.html` |
| `/apps/<slug>/` | `pages/app-<slug>.html` |
| `/tools/<slug>/` | `pages/tool-<slug>.html` (`/tools/free-tools/` uses `pages/recommended-free-tools.html`) |
| `/resources/<slug>/` | `pages/article-<slug>.html` |
| `/industries/<slug>/` | `pages/industry-<slug>.html` |
| `/frontdeskpro/`, `/frontdeskai/`, `/frontdeskagent/` | `pages/frontdeskpro.html`, `pages/frontdeskai.html`, `pages/frontdeskagent.html` |

## Hosting requirements

- The host must serve a folder's `index.html` for a URL ending in `/`.
- The host must serve the site over HTTPS, and redirect HTTP to HTTPS.
- The host must not run any server-side code from the site. The repository contains no `.php` or `.htaccess` files. If the host has any, they must be removed, because a compromised front controller was found on the previous host.
- Until these requirements are met, the `/frontdesk*` URLs will not serve correctly on the live domain, and no public links to them should be added.

## Release checklist

1. Edit `pages/`, regenerate the clean-URL folders, and check that every local link resolves.
2. Check the sitemap contains every public page.
3. Check that each page's canonical tag matches its public URL.
4. Load each changed page in a browser at a desktop width and a phone width, with no console errors and no horizontal scrolling.
5. Commit, then publish by copying the repository contents to the host (without `.git`).

## Rollback

- Each release is a commit on `main`. To roll back, check out the previous commit, copy its files to the host, and confirm the homepage and a sample app page load.
- Keep the previous release's files available on the host until the new release has been checked in production.

## Analytics and consent

- No analytics or tracking scripts are included in this repository.
- Do not add tracking until consent handling is in place. The planned funnel events and UTM conventions are tracked in the GitHub issues, not implemented here.

## Calculator release checks

The calculator logic is in `assets/tools-engine.js` (pure functions, integer cents for money). `assets/tools.js` only wires the pages. Every calculator page loads `tools-engine.js` before `tools.js`.

Reproducible checks (run from the repository root; Node 22, no install needed):

```bash
node --check assets/tools-engine.js && node --check assets/tools.js && node --check assets/site.js
node --test tests/break-even.test.mjs tests/tools-engine.test.mjs tests/tools-handoff-privacy.test.mjs tests/tools-legacy-url-privacy.test.mjs
node scripts/test-break-even.mjs
node scripts/check-tool-parity.mjs
```

Block a release if any command fails. The parity check fails when a `tools/<slug>/index.html` copy differs from `pages/tool-<slug>.html`, or when a calculator page loads `tools.js` before the engine.

Manual QA before publishing a calculator change (desktop and phone width):

1. Enter a blank, a negative, and a three-decimal money value; each shows a message and no result.
2. Break-even with price equal to variable cost shows "Not achievable", not 0 jobs.
3. Results move focus to the result heading; the copy button does not send data anywhere.
4. The page prints without the input fields being cut off.

Rollback: calculator changes are commits on `main`. Restore the previous commit's `assets/tools.js`, `assets/tools-engine.js` and the matching HTML, then confirm one calculator page loads and calculates.
